name: web-traffic-sources-donut-and-top-search-terms-cards-on-dark-gradient
title: White 'Traffic Sources' donut card with blue segments and legend, overlapped by a 'Top Search Terms' card with blue pills, on a black, teal and orange glow
whatItIs: A dark background with teal, orange and green glows at the bottom, a white rounded card 'Traffic Sources' with a donut chart in graduated blues and a legend (Behance For You, External Search Engine, Behance Search), and overlapping at the bottom a wider white card 'Top Search Terms' with rounded pale-blue pills containing a search icon, a term and a count (logo design 78, logo 56, cerulean 52).
whatItMeans: Clear and layered; overlapping white cards make analytics feel like a peek into a product.
techniques: Use graduated blues for donut segments.
Show terms as pills with counts.
Set on a glowing dark background.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule with an icon, keyword and count.
Cards placed partly over each other.
Steps of one hue from dark to light.
